notes: Read only the Certificate of Achievement section (State Code 21801, pages 83-84); the A.A. degree section above it lists the same courses plus ARC 272 with a 37-unit major total, which is not recorded here.
The certificate prints its own Program Learning Outcomes list, identical to the A.A. degree's list.

Careers left empty: the certificate description names architects, contractors, construction managers and engineers only as professionals students work alongside, and refers to the Gainful Employment website for careers. The A.A. section names 'architectural technicians' but that is outside this award's section.
Block stated total taken from 'CERTIFICATE - TOTAL UNITS 34'; the printed course units sum to 34.
Asterisks on course codes mark prerequisites/corequisites and were dropped from the codes.
